summary: Four findings recorded; TAR-016–018 reopened and M5 remains In progress. All 234 backend tests pass. TAR-020 excluded. No commit made.

findings.explanation: Verification can report PASS despite duplicate invoices, missing invoices or unbalanced journals. Independent probes reproduce these false positives.
The ingestion gate ignores subprocess failure and drops failed HTTP requests. Reused fixtures can also measure deduplication instead of ingestion.
Billing latency excludes rating. Reruns reuse historical operations, so saved timings and resource samples do not establish whole-run billing budgets.
Fixed-name completed migration Jobs do not rerun for upgrades; unchanged latest image references do not trigger deployment rollouts. A repeatable schema-upgrade procedure and evidence are missing.

verification_gaps: Fresh installation, schema upgrade, destructive fault campaign and R1 measurements were not independently rerun.
Browser journey, hosted CI and Sentry export were not rerun.
Live image source identity was not established; the network probe verified only unlabeled-pod PostgreSQL isolation.
